command_templates.name: geo_locate_logs
command_templates.when: When IIS logs need to be geolocated and converted to CSV for analysis.

usage_description: IISGeoLocate is used to geolocate IP addresses found in IIS Logs, converting them into a more analyzable format like CSV.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Unusual geographic locations for user activity.
suspicious_indicators.description: Indicates potential malicious or anomalous activity.
